column7: Decides whether a request skips the one sanitize step: exempt only when it has at least one backend target and every target is passthrough, a surfaced name judged on the caller view through the request memo; records the judged playbook digest the run compares (MIK-8154 SAN.1, C2e)

Re-admits a resumed task call: judges its sanitize exemption again against the current config on the caller view; still exempt it sends under the instances judged now, otherwise it sanitizes the stored arguments and a NUL refuses the resume (MIK-8154 B)

The direct route's one sanitize step: validates the protocol fields, then sanitizes the whole request unless the named backend is passthrough, whose instance it records for the send check (MIK-8154 SAN.1, F2)
